task_definition.task_description: Please hold 2 Sony XM5 headphones for me, then prepare the recommended invoice request for my account using my email and Stripe, and then generate the best-discount invoice for 2 units. After that, place the order with the best discount using my credit card, check the current New York time, convert the timestamp to a readable date and time, and save that as a note titled “Trip Summary” tagged finance and travel.
